RE, beta-carotene proportion, alpha-TE, NE and folic-acid form remain source qualifiers alongside canonical nutrient keys. The package and current official ingredient PDF agree on thiamin 1.7 mg; the 1.65 mg professional-page candidate remains separate rather than overwriting the package. No intake occurrence or schedule is created.

The distinctive text resolves the Boots product lineage, while front branding, barcode and historical package version remain uncaptured. interpretation: The cohort validates supplement-specific identity, compound, dose-form and serving-basis requirements but does not create intake events or a supplement catalogue. No observed page supplies an immutable release or formulation-effective date. The user-supplied Centrum, Solgar fish oil, Momentous zinc, AG and Boots psyllium labels are evidence-scoped package authority: Centrum directly measures 24 canonical micronutrients per tablet, Solgar measures fish-oil concentrate, EPA and DHA per two softgels and supports an exact one-softgel projection, Momentous measures 15 mg elemental zinc per capsule while retaining picolinate provenance, AG measures its printed six-drop values and supports an exact one-drop projection, and Boots psyllium separates component mass from supplied fibre at a direct 3.16 g basis. Their raw images remain local-only. Public pages may corroborate candidates, but malformed retailer rows, source-specific RI/Daily Value percentages, a 1.7-versus-1.65 mg thiamin difference, image-only labels, removed pages and a public psyllium mass-versus-fibre conflict demonstrate why current package evidence remains authoritative.
